label: NUMBER 1
head: The "you deserve it" friend
sub: Shows up every time you're about to buy something you don't need.

label: NUMBER 2
head: The "a job is enough" guy
sub: Never asks what happens if that paycheck stops tomorrow.

items.head: The raise splitter
items.sub: Wants every raise spent on a nicer life before you invest a cent.

items.head: The trend expert
items.sub: Knows every new restaurant. Knows nothing about taxes or assets.

label: NUMBER 5
head: The "it's a scam" guy
sub: Calls everything too risky because he never learned how it works.

head: 6: The friend who makes no feel cheap
r: I'm good. Let's do a cheap one Sunday.

label: NUMBER 7
head: 5 years of complaining, zero changes
sub: No new skill, no raise, no new habit. Same story every month.

text: Be careful who makes your bad money decisions *feel normal.*
